opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000 for research... In special cases, and by prior agreement, we accept applications for up to £750,000. Most of the grants we award are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research projects addressing one or more of the five priority questions. Proposals must be led by UK-based organisations; not open to individuals without formal employment/contract with the hosting institution, projects led by schools/FE colleges, undergraduates/master's students, PhD fees, or organisations not based in the UK (with exceptional overseas cases).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priorities and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn); the next outline application deadline is 5 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research on racial diversity within the UK. Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: 'Inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK' within the Inclusive Society priority. One deadline per year in Autumn; next deadline 5 October 2026.
